The score is an uncalibrated follow-up ranking, not Gaussian sigma. A candidate
is not confirmed artificial; NOT_FLAGGED does not establish natural origin. The
fixed reference population and dependent features still require scientific
This menu inspects the default canonical policy. Explicit custom service
policies and running jobs may have different recorded policy IDs. It does not
audit every running process. Alpha, legacy BIC and threshold mutation are
unavailable here; no settings are applied. Snapshot verification never imports a
runtime policy or changes required validation.
